title: Our Day in Order
short: Put the things we do in a day in order.

blocks.html: Every day has an order. We wake up, eat breakfast, eat lunch, eat dinner, and go to sleep. Some things always come first, like socks before shoes!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Wake up, eat breakfast, eat lunch.

blocks.html: Some things happen before others, every day.

For the grown-up: Talk through your day: “First we get dressed, then we go out.” A simple picture chart of your family’s day helps children know what comes next. Short and happy beats long. Five minutes is a good lesson.

items: Try it at home: Make a picture chart of your day.
Ask: what do we do after breakfast?
Put on socks, then shoes, and say first and next.
